files.description:
Another censor beep. Once again avoiding a traditional 1000hz sinewave and trying to make something original.
This time a 1005hz base with harmonic frequencies (1507.5 2010 4020hz)  of different wave shapes. I also applied a very light distortion on the 1005hz sinewave, flattening it a bit.
Fade in/
